brief.title: Brief
brief.description: Creative brief: the hook, what to show, the tone, and why it will get views

edits.title: Edits
edits.description: Optional JSON object: scene role -> effects, e.g. {"hook":[{"fx":"impact_text","text":"NOBODY NOTICED"}],"twist":["freeze","bw"]}

format.title: Format
format.description: Fact, Backstory, Fan Theory, Hidden Details, Who Would Win, Ranking, Quiz, What If, Behind the Scenes, Why It's Trending, Just Announced, Hype Check, This Week's Drops or Season Preview

reelId.title: Reel Id
reelId.description: External id of the slot from the event, e.g. R-20261129-AM

style.title: Style
style.description: Optional JSON object of style settings, e.g. {"transition":"flash","image_interval":1.8}; empty for the default look

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: The exact topic or angle, specific enough to hook in 1.5 seconds
